SELECT s.first_name
FROM Students s
JOIN Addresses a_curr ON s.current_address_id = a_curr.address_id
JOIN Addresses a_perm ON s.permanent_address_id = a_perm.address_id
WHERE s.current_address_id <> s.permanent_address_id;
